Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5606460. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id matching CHEMBL5606460, then inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
